notes: Visual Novel Maker: an exported package is Game.exe + index.html + package.json + icon.png + a 'signature' file + data/ and resources/ (http://asset.visualnovelmaker.com/help/Create_Game_Package.htm). All five markers are required together because the shell itself is plain NW.js/Electron; the payload is what identifies the engine, hence this row sits before the generic web-shell row.
